The '''Low'n system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Romintine sector/Legends|Romintine sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Low'n]].
